notes: The programme page is on DAAD, so the deadline is not stated with a specific year on the programme page. The application portal handles document recognition directly or via Studienkolleg Konstanz; no uni-assist is mentioned. The interview is required for non-EU applicants. The tuition fee is per semester for non-EU students.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 5.5
minimum B2 level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). TOEFL scores: minimum 72 (IBT), 188 (PBT), or 543 (ITP). IELTS score: minimum 5.5.
Individual grades of the university entrance qualification in mathematics = 30% Individual grades of the university entrance qualification in English = 20%

note.fr: Un entretien est obligatoire pour les candidats non-UE. Il doit avoir lieu avant le 15 juillet et sera évalué selon des critères définis.
note.en: An interview is required for non-EU applicants. It must take place before 15 July and is assessed on defined criteria.

evidence.quote: Yes, an interview is a requirement for non - EU students.

note.fr: Une note pondérée est calculée: 50% moyenne générale, 30% note de mathématiques, 20% note d'anglais. Un test d'aptitude facultatif peut améliorer le résultat.
note.en: A weighted grade is calculated: 50% overall average, 30% mathematics grade, 20% English grade. An optional aptitude test can improve the result.

evidence.quote: The weighted overall university entrance qualification grade is calculated as follows: Average grade of the higher education entrance qualification = 50% Individual grades of the university entrance qualification in mathematics [1] = 30% Individual grades of the university entrance qualification in English [2] = 20%
